coverage_gaps: Every name-confirmed undated record must remain visible without a invented day; notes preserve month clues and source conflicts.
NVIDIA coverage is curated foundation families, not all hundreds of NGC/HuggingFace research checkpoints; IBM older code/time-series/specialized variants remain outside this bounded pass.
StabilityCoreModels catalog is covered plus launch-history seeds; it explicitly excludes other vendor models, so this is not all Stability weights.
Runway research/catalog pages conflict on Gen-2 dates; use unresolved status. Product feature rebrands/availability milestones are not automatically distinct trained models.
Cohere official current models catalog and named Aya histories covered; legacy exact-day gaps remain. Embed5 dateSep30 is beyondcutoff.
FLUXTools submodels and FLUX2Max exact release dates not completely verified in this pass; do not claim exhaustive BFL history.
scope: Seven newly added vendors. Publicly named generative/general-purpose foundation model families and distinct variants documented in the reviewed official catalogs, launch articles and changelogs. No claim to all vendor research checkpoints, custom fine-tunes, quantizations or every historical unpublished model.
